title: Cyberparadism: Field Guide
description:
The reference site of the Cyberparadism aesthetic, relaunched in October 2026. It carries the maintained edition of the Cyberparadism Manifesto, a nine-chapter field guide (overview, settings and tropes, visual language, shape language, palette, distinctions, related aesthetics, checklist, glossary) and a gallery of pieces filed by setting and motif with stated provenance. All text and images are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
